SalesClaimViewDescription: This view aggregates sales claim data of eligible product for a specific promotion.
SalesClaimView:
SELECT
  "eligibleProductRewards"."productAttributeValue",
  "eligibleProductRewards"."reward",
  "sales"."id" AS "salesId",
  "sales"."quantity",
  "sales"."value",
  "sales"."userId",
  "users"."username",
  "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId"
FROM
  "users" AS "users"
  INNER JOIN "vw_promotion_eligible_audience" AS "vw_promotion_eligible_audience" ON (
    "users"."id" = "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."userId"
  )
  INNER JOIN "sales" AS "sales" ON (
    "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."userId" = "sales"."userId"
  )
  INNER JOIN "products" AS "products" ON (
    "sales"."productId" = "products"."id"
  )
  INNER JOIN "eligibleProductRewards" AS "eligibleProductRewards" ON (
    "products"."externalIdentifier" = "eligibleProductRewards"."productAttributeValue"
    AND "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId" = "eligibleProductRewards"."promotionId"
  )
  INNER JOIN "salesClaimHistories" AS "salesClaimHistories" ON (
    "sales"."userId" = "salesClaimHistories"."userId"
    AND "sales"."id" = "salesClaimHistories"."contextId"
  )
WHERE
  (
    "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId" = '{{promotionId}}'
    AND "eligibleProductRewards"."promotionId" = '{{promotionId}}'
  )
  AND ("products"."productStatus" = '1')
  AND ("sales"."origin" = 'nonEvidenceBasedClaim')
  AND ("salesClaimHistories"."status" = 'approved')
